title: A Probe Landed on Titan, a Moon Where Methane Soaks the Ground

scenes.text: A probe landed on a moon at minus 290 degrees.
In January 2005, the Huygens probe parachuted down to Saturn's moon Titan.
It hit the surface at about 10 miles an hour and sank in several inches.
The ground was like wet sand, soaked with liquid methane.
Methane in the air jumped about 30 percent as it touched down.
It kept sending data for over an hour from a moon where methane is the water.

description:
